judgments.comparative_verdict: Both reports hit every expectation with strong repository-grounded evidence and are comparable in quality.

report_1.evidence: "Patients can now export their full visit history as a PDF" (`highlights-v4.md:24`) — false.** The visit-history code, `app/routers/visits.py`, contains only a `GET /visits` endpoint that returns an empty list, and line 11 is literally `# TODO: pdf export`. ... "Two-factor authentication is now enabled for every clinic by default" (`highlights-v4.md:30`) — false.** `app/security/config.py` sets `TWO_FACTOR_DEFAULT = False`

report_2.evidence: "Two-factor authentication is now enabled for every clinic by default" — false.** `app/security/config.py:4` sets `TWO_FACTOR_DEFAULT = False` ... "Patients can now export their full visit history as a PDF" — false.** The only visit-history code, `app/routers/visits.py`, is a stub that returns an empty list, with `# TODO: pdf export` on line 11. The feature does not exist. ... Remove the entire section.

report_1.evidence: `captions.json` records `after_scheduling.png` as captured from route `/billing/invoices` (while `before_scheduling.png` came from `/schedule`), and opening the image confirms it: it shows a "BILLING / INVOICES" screen, whereas the "before" shows "SCHEDULING CALENDAR".

report_2.evidence: `before_scheduling.png` shows "SCHEDULING CALENDAR", but `after_scheduling.png` shows "BILLING / INVOICES". The manifest confirms this was not a labeling slip in the image itself: `captures.json` records `after_scheduling.png` as captured from route `/billing/invoices`

report_1.evidence: one referenced image with no file (`after_export.png`), and one file with no reference or manifest entry (`unused_capture_07.png`)

report_2.evidence: `img/after_export.png` | **No** | Broken reference ... And one file on disk is referenced by nothing: **`img/unused_capture_07.png`**, which shows "PATIENT LIST". It appears in neither the document nor `captures.json`.

report_1.evidence: the footer at `highlights-v4.md:33`: "*Highlights draft assembled with AI assistance.*" ... The **AI-assistance attribution** is an internal provenance note.

report_2.evidence: **The footer "Highlights draft assembled with AI assistance." (line 33)** is an internal drafting note. ... Remove it (or replace it with a deliberate, approved disclosure if one is required).
